audit.why: Akshan holding levels 1-5 and the lane going even at two items matches 52% over 25 games. The content layer already states the reason correctly - his damage is physical, so neither Void Stone nor the Null Sphere shield blanks it - so this never becomes a free scaling matchup. Chart left as is.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d invited you to punish 'the fifteen-second invitation' on Heroic Swing.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, so fifteen seconds is only true at rank 3. Comeuppance is 100/85/70s and Avengerang is 9/8/7/6/5s - those are the windows that decide when you step up.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single biggest interaction in this matchup was absent: Comeuppance 'deals damage based on missing health to the FIRST champion, minion, or structure hit'. Any minion between you and Akshan eats the whole ultimate. Also missing: Avengerang extends its range each time it hits an enemy, so hiding behind the wave makes it reach further, not shorter.
audit.why: Both come straight from Riot's ability text and both change where you stand.
audit.corrected: Added to full.report[5].t, full.loading, content.spikes[3].text and content.wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was three lines of boilerplate with no numbers.
audit.why: Heroic Swing at 18s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown, and it also needs terrain to anchor to - it is not always available even when it is up.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Heroic Swing 18s + terrain requirement, Avengerang 9s, Comeuppance 100s.

audit.why: Fleet Footwork plus Second Wind and Bone Plating is the right answer to ranged physical poke, and the page already runs it. No change.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer told you your passive soaks his poke ('Soak magic poke with passive + Q shield', 'If his damage is magic, your Q eats it') while the content layer correctly says his damage is physical. The two layers contradicted each other.
audit.why: Every damage source in Akshan's kit is physical, so Void Stone's magic reduction and Null Sphere's magic shield both read zero here - the item answer is armour and Zhonya's, not MR.
audit.corrected: Rewrote full.tldr, full.report[0].t, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[0].d and report[8].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Revive a fed ally off you' never said what makes you revivable.
audit.why: Going Rogue marks enemies as Scoundrels only when they kill his allies; if Akshan then kills that Scoundrel, the dead ally comes back. Not taking the kill is the counterplay.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[2] now names the Scoundrel mark.

edits.after: Every point of his damage is physical, so your Q shield reads zero - level 6 and the Riftwalk blink are the whole plan.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your Q shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 and it has to anchor into terrain, so a wall-less step-up is free for you. - Avengerang is 9s at rank 1; once it is out, he has only autos. - Comeuppance: 100/85/70s.

edits.before: Track Akshan’s Heroic Swing: His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure it hits - always keep a minion in that line.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield or Ring by lane. Tear early, Rod of Ages into Mercs or Sorcs, then Seraph's Embrace and Zhonya's.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield. Tear, Rod of Ages into Mercs, then Seraph's and Zhonya's - he is physical, so armour beats MR.

edits.before: Commit on Heroic Swing’s cooldown, on your Rod of Ages spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit while Heroic Swing is on its 18 seconds, on your Rod of Ages spike, and with your jungler. His escape goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: - Kassadin vs Akshan - Track: Akshan Heroic Swing. - No trades before 6 — not one. - No commits into Heroic Swing. - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Kassadin vs Akshan - Track: Heroic Swing, 18s at rank 1 and it needs terrain to anchor. - No trades before 6 - not one. - Keep a minion in his Comeuppance line.

edits.after: Stacked Riftwalk plus Nashor's/Lich Bane lets you blink-execute him, but he scales too - close it before two crit items, and never let Comeuppance find you with no minion in the line.

edits.after: Roam with terrain camouflage, then kill the Scoundrel who killed his ally - that revive is why you avoid the kill

edits.after: Full kit and still underpowered: his physical poke ignores Void Stone, and Avengerang stretches further every enemy it clips, so hiding in the wave does not shorten it.

edits.after: Full kit and still underpowered - and Avengerang reaches further through the wave, not less, so there is no safe stack.

notes: Heroic Swing 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions', and Kassadin's Void Stone 'ignores unit collision'. Whether Kassadin's body can therefore never break the swing is an inference I could not confirm from Riot's text, so I did not write it - logged in unverified. Also note the full layer for this matchup shipped the generic 'if his damage is magic, your Q eats it' template while the content layer correctly called him physical; that contradiction is now fixed on the full side.
